gameDescriptionHtml:
Begin your first quest as a Paladin in this isometric Action RPG with weighty, stamina driven combat. Delve into the depths of the Crater, then fortify your positions and survive relentless enemy waves in tactical action-tower defense battles. Can you rebuild a shattered Order?

Game Features

  • Impactful and Varied Combat – Stand against dark forces with a combat system that is challenging yet fair. Dedicate your successful quests to the Pantheon and gain their blessings. Gather various divine relics and tap their powers. Do you want to be a Sanctified Juggernaut, smashing evil into fragments? An Unyielding Stalwart, watching while wicked washes off your proud armor? The choice is yours.
  • Defend Your Fortress – Your success draws the ire of local Warlords. A challenge issued; and one the Warlords are happy to respond to. Hold fast against the armies brought to bear against the Paladin Order’s Fort. However, wielding a fast blade will not be enough to prevail. Utilize traps, turrets and barricades devised by the clever members of your Order, while the stronger members will follow your orders on the battlefield.
  • Rebuild Your Shattered Order – As Titus and his Order venture deeper into the Crater, there are opportunities to add valuable skills to the fledgling Order. Recruit, rescue or persuade those whose skills may give the Order another edge against evil.
  • Paladin Acolyte’s Journey – Titus follows his Master and their foundling Order and descends into the Crater, an ugly scar gouged into the heart of the Old Empire. As a Paladin Acolyte, Titus is still learning the blade and deciding whether a Paladin’s life is for him. When the Crater turns out to be far more dangerous than they expected, the new Order must band together to survive.
